items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: This great conductor you have. Bernstein.

ctx.x: And he was not a good player.

Well, he started with a bugle and then he started with trumpet. And when he came out, he couldn't read nothing. He went on the boat with Faith and stayed about three or four years. When he come off that boat, he was reading his ass off. He was reading then. He was reading ever since. And he made a record. One of his best records was in Hollywood with this symphony band in New York. This great conductor you have. Bernstein. Did you hear that record?
